news_items.headline: Allstate Q1 2026 EPS of $10.65 beats consensus of $7.31 by $3.34; revenue $16.94B vs. $15.24B estimate
news_items.summary: Allstate reported a strong Q1 2026 beat driven by lower catastrophe losses and increased policies in force, with EPS of $10.65 vs. street consensus of $7.31 and revenue of $16.94B vs. $15.24B expected.

news_items.headline: Allstate announces $4 billion share buyback program
news_items.summary: Allstate announced a $4 billion share repurchase program alongside Q1 earnings, signaling management confidence in financial health and capital position.

news_items.headline: Piper Sandler raises Allstate price target to $268 from $252
news_items.summary: Piper Sandler raised its price target on ALL to $268 from $252 following the Q1 2026 earnings beat.

news_items.headline: Citi raises Allstate price target to $226 from $221
news_items.summary: Citi raised its price target on ALL to $226 from $221, also following Q1 2026 results, a more modest adjustment than Piper Sandler.

news_items.headline: US Bancorp DE trims position in The Allstate Corporation
news_items.summary: US Bancorp DE disclosed a reduced position in ALL in a regulatory filing dated May 2, 2026; no specific rationale provided in the filing.

analyst_consensus.recent_changes: Piper Sandler raised PT to $268 from $252 on 2026-05-01; Citi raised PT to $226 from $221 on 2026-05-01, both following the Q1 2026 earnings beat. 17 analysts covering ALL carry a consensus Buy rating with average PT of $226.88.

earnings_context.notes: Q1 2026 reported approximately 2026-05-01 with a large beat ($10.65 EPS vs. $7.31 consensus); Q2 2026 report is scheduled for 2026-07-30. No near-term earnings catalyst within 7 days.
